Since my obtainable set will likely be {y, z}, and y is far more valuable to me than z ($58 vs $56), I want to maximize my chances of getting into y. Ranking w and x higher than z won't help, as I'm unlikely to get them. Ranking z higher than w or x won't change my outcome either, as I'm only interested in y. The optimal strategy is to rank my preferred schools in an order that doesn't hurt my chances of getting into my most desired school within my obtainable set.

Therefore, I will rank y first, then w, then x, then z. This doesn't change my obtainable set, but ensures I get the best possible outcome *within* that set.
